name: Builton — black & high-vis construction

source.method: Computed styles measured in Chromium at 1440px (scripts/extract-template.mjs → measured.json); reference-1..6.jpg are the full page in order. Grey 'PHOTO' tiles are photo slots — keep their size and shape, fill them with the lead's real photos.

character: Bold, editorial construction brand. A wide geometric display face (Unbounded) paired with DM Sans, a black / white / high-vis-yellow palette, square corners everywhere, angled cuts (chamfered hero panel, diagonal yellow stripes, slanted card tops), circular photo frames with a thin yellow ring, outlined giant step numerals. Feels like a serious contractor with an architect's eye.
reuse: Use for construction / general contractor / builder / renovation / remodeling / roofing / concrete / excavation / architecture / handyman leads that want a bold, premium, industrial look. Put the lead's brand colour in the yellow 'accent' slot (keep text on it dark if it is light); keep black and white as the base.

display.note: Wide geometric display for ALL headings (h1 64/700, h2 48/500, card titles 20/500). Its width is the brand — don't substitute.

scale.note: black text on a yellow brush-stroke shape

color.notes: Strict black / white / one accent. The accent appears as solid blocks (buttons, top-bar slant, diagonal stripes, pricing card tops) — never as a gradient. Dark sections use a faint topographic line pattern.

spacing.container: 1280px max content column with 32px side padding (20px under 768px) — the SAME column for top bar, header, every section and footer. (Template measured 1310px; standardised to 1280 so every mockup shares one grid.)
spacing.sectionPaddingY: 120px on light sections; dark services band ~120px with 55px bottom
spacing.headingStack: yellow lightning-bolt mark (centred sections) → 14px uppercase eyebrow → 10px → 48px h2 → 60px → content
spacing.header: 50px top bar (yellow slanted block with phone/email on the left, black right with socials) + a white 100px header BOX inset in the container (not full-bleed) floating over the hero
spacing.hero: ~980px tall grey-photo hero; centred black panel (845px wide, top-left corner chamfered at 45°, a faint grid texture) holding the brush eyebrow, h1, 16px subline and a yellow button; big diagonal yellow stripes in the bottom corners

components.button: Square corners. Solid yellow, 19px 51px, 14px/600 uppercase +0.7px tracking, black text. Secondary: white with 2px yellow border.
components.circleServices: Black band with topographic lines and a ruler-tick border at the top. 3 services, each a 410px circular photo framed by a thin yellow ring offset ~14px, then a 20px Unbounded white title and centred 16px text.
components.aboutSplit: Overlapping photo collage left (470×677 + 248×265 + a black circular badge with the logo mark and a dashed ring), text right: eyebrow, 48px h2, paragraph, a bold 16px statement with a 2px black left rule, two icon+label feature lines at 24px, yellow button; a diagonal yellow stripe runs behind.
components.pricingCard: 3-up, white with 1px border, the top half is a yellow shape with a slanted top edge holding a cut-out machine/photo; plan name 20px uppercase; zebra rows (#f4f4f4) of service/price; outline yellow button. Only use with real prices from FACTS — otherwise reuse this card shape for services.
components.processBand: Full-bleed dark photo split into 4 columns by 1px vertical lines; each column bottom has an OUTLINED 100px numeral '01'–'04' and a 20px white title. The heading row above it is left h2 + right paragraph.
components.teamCard: Bordered card with the photo inside, name 20px uppercase Unbounded, role, social row.
components.marquee: 67px full-bleed black strip scrolling uppercase service words separated by yellow star glyphs.
components.locations: Dark pattern band, heading left-aligned white, 3 dark #171715 cards with address and phone.
components.footer: Black with background image, 3 columns (contact info, links, newsletter input with dark 59px field), 20px uppercase Unbounded column titles +0.8px tracking.

blueprint.spec: yellow/black 50px top bar, white header box inset in the container over the hero
photo + centred black chamfered panel with brush eyebrow, 64px h1, subline, yellow button; diagonal yellow stripes
black topographic band, 3 ring-framed circular photos with titles
photo collage + badge left, text & features right, yellow diagonal stripe
#f4f4f4 band, centred heading with bolt mark, 3 slanted-top cards
left h2 + right paragraph, then the full-bleed 4-column outlined-numeral process band
centred heading, 3 bordered team cards (only with real team photos)
black scrolling strip of the lead's services
white, large quote left with 40px heading, photo right
dark photo band with a form

signatureMoves: Unbounded wide display for every heading
Square corners on every button, card and input
Chamfered (45° cut) black hero panel with a brush-stroke yellow eyebrow
Circular photos with a thin offset yellow ring
Outlined giant step numerals on a full-bleed band divided by thin vertical rules
Diagonal yellow stripe shapes breaking the grid
